iOS 26.6 is now available for iPhone users to update. Here's everything you need to know about this update, and why it's more important than you might think.

iOS 26.6 Details

Apple released the first iOS 26.6 beta on May 26, followed by four additional beta versions issued to developers and public beta testers. Last week, Apple rolled out the iOS 26.6 release candidate (RC).

After two months of beta testing, iOS 26.6 officially launched to all users on Monday, July 27. You can update by going to the Settings app on your iPhone, selecting General, then Software Update. You can choose to install the update immediately, or schedule it to install automatically overnight.

What's New in iOS 26.6

Most of Apple's focus has shifted to iOS 27, so iOS 26.6 isn't a major update for iPhone users. However, it does include one very important change that lays the groundwork for this fall's iOS 27 update.

Siri AI is the headlining feature of iOS 27, and it requires reindexing your iPhone. This process happens in the background while you continue using your iPhone.

iOS 27 will officially launch to all users this fall. Apple says that ahead of iOS 27's release, iOS 26.6 will "optimize" your iPhone's Spotlight indexing in preparation for iOS 27. This way, when you upgrade to iOS 27 later this year, the indexing process should run more smoothly.

Here is Apple's full release notes for iOS 26.6: "This update includes bug fixes, security updates, and optimizes Spotlight indexing in preparation for iOS 27."

Beyond that iOS 27 optimization, iOS 26.6 is light on new features. The update adds a new alert that displays when you block too many contacts. Code in iOS 26.6 also indicates Apple is developing a new anti-iPhone-snatching feature, but it doesn't appear that functionality will launch as part of this update.

Important Security Fixes

Finally, iOS 26.6 patches more than 75 security vulnerabilities affecting iPhones. That alone should be reason enough to update your iPhone to iOS 26.6 right away.

iOS 26.6 Bottom Line

Have you spotted any other new features in iOS 26.6? Have you jumped to the iOS 27 beta yet? Let us know in the comments.
